# gitea_repository_actions_artifacts (Data Source)

Lists repository Actions artifacts.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "gitea_repository_actions_artifacts" "example" {
  repository_owner = "my-org"
  repository       = "my-repo"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `repository` (String) The repository name.
- `repository_owner` (String) The repository owner.

### Optional

- `name` (String) Filter artifacts by name.
- `run_id` (Number) List artifacts for a specific run when set.

### Read-Only

- `artifacts` (List of Object) The matching repository artifacts. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--artifacts))
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `total_count` (Number)

<a id="nestedatt--artifacts"></a>
